status: derived-schema-variant; owner-approved D-6; this is a schema, not evidence
purpose: QA-scoped G3 evidence-subset schema for protocol bandroom-d2-cloud-recovery-v1-qa-diagnostic. Enumerates every relaxation against the frozen G5 schema so QA evidence can never be passed off as formal G5 evidence. The frozen G5 schema and the formal verifier are preserved byte-for-byte.

authority.separation: A QA-scoped manifest is rejected by the formal verify_bundle guard before signature verification. A formal manifest is rejected by check_qa(). The QA exporter refuses to run without --qa-scoped.
authority.formalCandidateIdentityFields: must stay null in a QA bundle: sourceSha, sourceTreeSha, buildSha256, runtimeBundleSha256, modelWeightsSha256, configSha256

roles.name: work-auditor
roles.keyHolderIndependence: must be a different holder from site-auditor (MJ13) or the limitation is disclosed

roles.name: site-auditor
roles.keyHolderIndependence: must be a different holder from work-auditor (MJ13) or the limitation is disclosed

qaManifest.analysisVersion: non-empty QA diagnostic label; never a formal release identity
qaManifest.environmentId: non-empty QA diagnostic label; never a formal release identity
qaManifest.files: map filename -> 64 lowercase hex over the QA-named artifacts and G3-owned exports
qaManifest.signatureStatus: unsigned-keys-absent when the owner accepts the unsigned bundle
qaManifest.signatureRoles: work-auditor and site-auditor are both absent for an unsigned bundle
qaManifest.runDArtifacts: the confirmed V5 disposition binds both source reports and lists all 12 original files as missing

qaArtifactBindings.qaRuntimeBundleSha256: manifest.files['qa-runtime-bundle.zip']; QA-named artifact binds its own digest, never the formal runtimeBundleSha256
qaArtifactBindings.qaModelWeightsSha256: manifest.files['qa-model-weights.bin']; QA-named artifact binds its own digest
qaArtifactBindings.qaConfigSha256: manifest.files['qa-analysis-config.json']; QA-named artifact binds its own digest

qaBundle.supplementaryEvidence: SHA-bound copies of the original QA checkpoints and cloud readbacks. The V26 cold.bin and resumed.bin retain their original names and scope.
qaBundle.signatureFiles: work-auditor.sig and site-auditor.sig, detached over the exact manifest.json bytes; absent signatures are allowed only when both role keys are absent and the bundle is explicitly labelled unsigned-keys-absent
notRequired: acoustic-NN.bin formal plan chunks when D bytes were not recovered (V5 hard gate: label missing, never substitute)

relaxations.reason: Hard QA/formal separation (BL4); formal verifier rejects qaScoped manifests.

relaxations.frozen: formal candidate identity required and digest-bound
relaxations.qa: identityScope == 'qa-diagnostic'; formal candidate fields are null; QA identity fields are per-field disclosed (attemptIdSynthetic, attemptRevisionSynthetic, analysisVersionScope, recordingIdScope)
relaxations.reason: Synthetic QA identity must never enter a formal package (MJ10).

relaxations.frozen: four roles: release-owner, holdout-custodian, work-auditor, site-auditor
relaxations.qa: two G3 roles only: work-auditor and site-auditor; unsigned-if-keys-absent is an explicit label, not a pass
relaxations.reason: G3 requires two roles; formal G5 four roles are out of scope (D-5).

relaxations.frozen: all 10 BROWSER_CASES plus slow-loadedmetadata, repeat-marker, pause, reopen (14 cases)
relaxations.qa: 6 contract §5.2 core cases only: playback, pause, refresh, reopen, slow-loadedmetadata, repeat-marker; §5.3 eight cases are status='deferred/N-A' with releaseRetest53
relaxations.reason: G3 §5.2 six-case scope per contract :130; §5.3 is a release retest (:140).

relaxations.frozen: learnerBaselineBefore/After equal and contain PRESERVED keys; rollbackVerified=true; archive case passed
relaxations.qa: learnerBaselineScope='not-applicable-qa' with an explicit disclosure; learnerBaselineBefore/After MAY be null; rollbackVerified MAY be null; archive case is N/A
relaxations.reason: QA has no learner data and production must not be touched (D-2c).

relaxations.qa: either the frozen evidence, or emptyQueueWakesWaived=true bound to history.observationWaiver plus formalG5ObservationWaived=false plus an explicit waiver label; waived checks are never recorded as passed
relaxations.reason: Owner 24h observation waiver must be explicit and must not leak into formal G5 (BL3).

relaxations.qa: event-level receiptId/feedbackId are required on feedback_committed and receipt_readback and are deterministically derived when absent: receiptId='rcpt-'+payloadSha256[:32], feedbackId='fb-'+payloadSha256[:32]; derivation is labelled receiptIdentitySource

relaxations.frozen: 12 fields: jobId, taskId, attemptId, attemptRevision, recordingId, recordingSha256, inputBytes, analysisVersion, fence, id, feedbackId, outputSha256
relaxations.qa: required id, feedbackId, inputBytes (=441322), officialRecordRef; remaining frozen fields are carried when available or explicitly null-disclosed; recordingId may be null with recordingIdSource; id/feedbackId are deterministically derived from payloadSha256
relaxations.reason: QA backfill is read-time enrichment, not a new run; 441322 B is the fixed HJK original (BL1/BL4).

relaxations.qa: officialRefs must be an object with A/B/C entries, each carrying a lowercase-UUID officialRunId; turn fields are optional enrichment when the platform exposes them
relaxations.reason: officialRunId is the accepted equivalent immutable run reference (D-1b/MJ2).

relaxations.frozen: every history run carries a non-empty officialRecordRef
relaxations.qa: officialRecordRef is projected from the run's officialRunId and labelled officialRecordRefSource='projected-from-officialRunId'; it may never be invented
relaxations.reason: The server does not expose a separate record reference (MJ12).

relaxations.frozen: startedAt/endedAt are platform-observed, non-null, and 0 < duration <= 900 s
relaxations.qa: when a platform timestamp is unavailable it is derived from a named observed field and carries endedAtSource/startedAtSource (for example executionEndObservedAt); an underivable field stays null and is disclosed, never fabricated
relaxations.reason: Platform fields are unavailable for B/D (MJ12).

relaxations.frozen: numeric stage fields are present and positive
relaxations.qa: absent/null means not observed, 0 means measured zero, and every stage ledger labels which semantic applies; no zero or positive value may be substituted for an unmeasured stage

relaxations.frozen: 8 stages and an exact four-probe matrix with 300/900 budgets
relaxations.qa: G3 QA uses the single V4 cold measurement with 1520/1800 second execution limits and empty measured matrix arrays. Formal G5 requires the full pipeline, the complete matrix and 300/900 second budgets.
relaxations.reason: The owner accepted the V4 budget evidence and waived the M4 matrix after officialRunId and the Work code bridge were unavailable.

relaxations.qa: either a real multi-task fairness readback, or fairnessScope='not-applicable-qa' with an explicit disclosure; the block is never synthesized
relaxations.reason: No evidence source exists for a QA fairness scenario (MJ4).

relaxations.qa: qa-runtime-bundle.zip/qa-model-weights.bin/qa-analysis-config.json bind their own digests; the formal candidate fields stay null and QA digests never masquerade as G5 file-object digests
relaxations.reason: QA digests differ from G5 file objects (B-M16).

relaxations.frozen: gates.releaseEligible=true, G0..G5 passed, zero-cost attestation signed
relaxations.qa: gates.json and zero-cost.json are not part of the QA evidence subset; a QA bundle must not claim releaseEligible
relaxations.reason: G3 QA is not a release (G3 != D2; §0 non-goals).

relaxations.qa: D bytes must be recovered through the V5 hard gate; if unavailable the files are marked missing/G1-G2-dependent and are never relabelled from the v26 prefix or copied from the QA diagnostic output
relaxations.reason: V5 hard gate; no inventory inflation (BL6).

offline.runs: exactly 3, step order ['A','B','C']; each carries officialRunId, fence, automationId and the QA identity disclosure; candidate fields are null
offline.coldRunId: run D officialRunId when available; distinct from A/B/C; never reuse C

feedbackReceipt.officialRecordRef: C officialRunId (or the projected record reference)
feedbackReceipt.derivation: receiptIdentitySource='derived-from-payloadSha256'; never claim a fresh server receipt
feedbackReceipt.nullDisclosure: recordingId may be null with recordingIdSource; unobserved fields are null, not fabricated

qaIdentityScope.attemptIdSynthetic: QA attempt ids are labelled synthetic when derived
qaIdentityScope.recordingIdScope: recordingId is not the recording SHA; prefer null + recordingIdSource
qaIdentityScope.analysisVersionScope: QA diagnostic label, never a formal release analysis version

officialRunHistory.runs: A/B/C plus D when available; officialRunId required; officialRecordRef projected and labelled; startedAt/endedAt may be derived with *Source fields

waiverForm.emptyQueueWakesWaiverLabel: explicit label naming the owner waiver and date
waiverForm.note: the waived checks are reported WAIVED, never passed; the 24h claim is 243/244 + waiver, not 244/244

siteEventExport.events: 11 cloud events with the 9 G5 types when the full A/B/C sequence exists; no offline_run/wake/drain rows

eventLevelReceipt.derivation: receiptId/feedbackId derived from payloadSha256 and labelled

feedbackReceiptFile.binding: equals offline.feedbackReceipt and the event-level receipt fields

browserAcceptance.slowLoadedMetadataExecution: Recorded method for a passed trial in native Chrome DevTools and the playback UI. Owner-authorized Computer Use identifies the operator and its read-only media trace method. Null when unavailable.
browserAcceptance.repeatMarkerDeviation: contract asks for consecutive clicks on different markers; using the same marker is a disclosed deviation (B-m2)

signatures.signed: work-auditor.sig and site-auditor.sig are non-empty detached Ed25519 signatures over manifest.json
signatures.unsignedKeysAbsent: both signatures absent and both role keys unavailable; label 'unsigned (owner keys absent)' is emitted and is not a passed signature check

checkQaOrder: 1. reject a non-QA manifest: protocol must be the QA namespace, qaScoped must be true, identityScope must be qa-diagnostic
2. reject formal candidate identity: sourceSha/sourceTreeSha/buildSha256/runtimeBundleSha256/modelWeightsSha256/configSha256 must be null
3. verify the QA file inventory and every listed digest
4. verify offline A/B/C runs and distinct official run ids
5. verify official-run-history runs, officialRefs A/B/C officialRunId UUIDs, and the emptyQueueWakes waiver binding
6. verify site-event-export cloud sequences and event-level receiptId/feedbackId derivation
7. verify qa-feedback-receipt required fields, 441322 inputBytes, and deterministic id/feedbackId
8. verify two-role signatures or emit the explicit unsigned-keys-absent label
9. this is a QA-scoped G3 result, never a formal G5 pass
prohibitions: Never write qaScoped:true into the formal namespace or omit qaScoped from the QA namespace.
Never fill a formal candidate field with a QA digest or a null-disguised value.
Never claim 244/244, formal G5 pass, or 24h evidence without the waiver disclosure.
Never fabricate wakes, fairness, human reviews, stage timings, official references, or D bytes.
Never relabel v26 prefix files as acoustic-NN.bin or copy the QA diagnostic output as offline-output.
